local_qft_functor.field_algebra: the self-dual CAR algebra of that positive one-particle object; odd fields are graded local
local_qft_functor.isotony: extension by zero of test sections induces injective star-homomorphisms for causally convex inclusions
local_qft_functor.local_covariance: spin-lift and q79-connection preserving embeddings intertwine D_q79 and its Green operators, hence induce a covariant CAR functor and an unambiguous even observable functor
local_qft_functor.observable_net: A_q79^even(O), the fermion-parity fixed subnet; spacelike separated even algebras commute
local_qft_functor.one_particle_object: compactly supported spinor/cospinor test sections modulo the Dirac equation, with causal-propagator Cauchy form
local_qft_functor.statistics_source: the causal Dirac Cauchy form and positivity give the CAR functor; curved-spacetime spin-statistics excludes a nontrivial wrong local grading under its stated hypotheses
local_qft_functor.time_slice: a Cauchy inclusion induces an isomorphism because the advanced/retarded Green operators move every test class into any neighborhood of a Cauchy surface

parameter_ledger.chosen_spin_lift_is_representative_data: yes; the even net removes the functorial sign/cohomology ambiguity on a fixed spin category, not inequivalent global spin structures

q79_continuum_observable_map.boundary: this maps the selected finite P/Q algebra into continuum free-field components; it does not identify SM particles, interacting composites or measured masses
q79_continuum_observable_map.even_components: bilinears Psi*(P_a f)Psi(P_b h) define local observables
q79_continuum_observable_map.intertwining: [D_q79,P_Haar]=[D_q79,Q]=0, so causal propagation, region embeddings and the P/Q component maps commute

selected_domain.background: the q79/F globally hyperbolic time-oriented Lorentzian realization after A_QG and A_causal
selected_domain.framed_category: causally convex globally hyperbolic subregions carrying the restricted coframe and parallel q79 finite bundle; morphisms preserve orientation, time orientation, metric, finite connection and a chosen spin lift
selected_domain.scope: one selected-background framed/spin subcategory, not all Lorentzian manifolds and not a unique cosmic state
selected_domain.spin_lift_guard: a chosen global coframe induces a trivial spin lift; the field algebra remembers the chosen spin structure; the even observable algebra removes the functorial cohomological construction ambiguity within that spin category, but this does not identify inequivalent global spin structures

state_space.assignment: S_Had(O) is the nonempty convex set of positive normalized quasifree states whose two-point distribution has the Dirac Hadamard wavefront set
state_space.covariance: pullback along admissible embeddings preserves the Hadamard wavefront condition
state_space.positivity: states are positive normalized functionals on the CAR C-star algebra; restriction gives positive states on the even observable subnet
state_space.preferred_state: not selected; a locally covariant preferred vacuum would conflict with the natural-state no-go in the generic dynamically local setting
